recovery_command_gate: Execute only against new isolated recovery target, never production volume/database/service
Obtain BUNDLE from exact completed Kopiur Restore target; do not synthesize or substitute a fixture
Verify every bundle checksum and terminal Restore phase Completed before running native command

For Tube Archivist precreate exact reviewed catalog with restored mappings/settings/aliases in new ES, inspect bulk response errors/items, restore Django SQL and original auth; this command alone is not acceptance
For Plex/Stash extract state archive into empty target and replay native DB copies, never raw live DB/WAL files
For RomM restore assets/resources, effective config and original auth key before isolated native boot
